name: OpenFDA API
tagline: U.S. FDA public datasets for drugs, devices, food, and adverse events
description: OpenFDA provides REST access to U.S. Food and Drug Administration public data, including drug and device adverse events, product labeling, recalls, and other regulated-product datasets. Developers query structured endpoints with optional API keys for higher rate limits, making it useful for pharmacovigilance research, compliance tooling, and consumer-safety applications.

auth.details: Optional API key as query parameter api_key=YOUR_API_KEY; self-serve key via open.fda.gov. Unauthenticated access allowed at lower rate limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; higher limits with free API key (see rate_limits)

rate_limits: Without key: 240 req/min, 1,000/day (per IP). With key: 240 req/min, 120,000/day (per key).

example.response_snippet: {"meta":{"disclaimer":"Do not rely on openFDA to make decisions regarding medical care...","results":{"skip":0,"limit":1,"total":...}},"results":[{"safetyreportid":"...","patient":{...}}]}

use_cases: search FDA drug adverse event reports by brand or generic name
look up drug labeling and indications from FDA label data
query medical device recalls and adverse events
find food enforcement and recall notices
check NDC or product codes against openFDA drug datasets
